addedOperations.reason: Reviewed additive public operation that closes SB-013. The contact surface previously rendered four inputs and a control labelled as sending a message to support, wired to a mailto link that opened an empty draft and discarded everything typed; this operation accepts that message instead. It is unauthenticated by necessity because the sender is a member of the public, and is therefore bounded on every axis this manifest tracks: CSRF origin verification, a five-per-minute rate limit keyed on a hashed network fingerprint rather than a raw address, a 12 KB bounded body, a required idempotency key so a double click is one message rather than two, no-store responses, and fail-closed handling that answers 503 rather than reporting success when storage is unavailable. Personal data is envelope-encrypted at rest under the existing CRM key, consent and privacy-notice version are mandatory and stored beside the message, and the row carries a six-month retention bound enforced by a sweep. No authenticated capability, admin surface, custody path, exchange activation or financial mutation is reachable from this operation. Re-reviewed after the intake gained an idempotency-conflict answer: a reused key carrying a different payload now returns 409 rather than resolving as the previously stored message, so an edited retry cannot be reported as sent.
